description.content: Returns a collection of opportunities (services/programs). Supports full-text, geo, tag, and property search.

query.description: The page offset. Default is 1.
Number of items to return. Default is 10.
Return only titles/basic info instead of full resource objects.
Comma-separated set of IDs whose records will be returned.
Full-text search keywords. Surround in quotes for exact phrase.
Classification tags associated with opportunities.
Latitude around which to search.
Longitude around which to search.
Radius in kilometers around the coordinates to search within.
Ordering of results (default scored by best match, distance and other factors).
Match logic: any, properties, or by_type.

info.name: One Degree Resource Server Housing Opportunities API

description.content:
The One Degree Resource Server API provides read access to a curated database of social-service community resources — organizations and the opportunities (programs/services) they offer, along with locations, phones, schedules, ratings, tags, comments, images, properties, guides, and housing properties. One Degree is a California 501(c)(3) nonprofit; the API supports interoperability with third-party services to improve coordination and delivery of social services. Data is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. All requests require an api_key query parameter; write verbs (POST/PUT/DELETE) additionally require HMAC-SHA256 request signatures via the 1deg-Date and 1deg-Signature headers.

Contact Support:
 Name: One Degree
